title: Research Run State Contract
description: Minimal process-state contract for long-running or multi-track research (issue #417). phase is the pipeline stage; status is the run overlay. This is not a second interpretation of Research Pack research_status / Final audit status / delivery_status. Runtime enforcement lives in scripts/validate_research_run_state.py. Single-track research does not create a Run State unless the user explicitly resumes a previous run_id.

then.description: partial and blocked runs must record the gap or block and its impact.
blocked runs must state how the run can be resumed.
delivered is the success terminal: status must be completed and pending_decision must be consumed.
mid_review is a mandatory user checkpoint.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers reject unknown versions instead of guessing.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this run, e.g. research-run-2026-08-25-001. Unchanged across pause/resume.

artifact_id.description: Identity of the process artifact this run is bound to (typically the Research Pack artifact_id).

phase.description: Pipeline stage. Not a result status: partial/blocked/completed are status values, never phases.

status.description: Run overlay. Mapping to Research Pack: partial/blocked may correspond to research_status; completed does not prove content-audit Pass or delivery_status=md_ready. paused/in_progress/phase are process-only and must not be written as Pack research_status.

current_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the current process artifact bytes (the Research Pack file identified by artifact_id). Hash change invalidates delivered and any audit/handoff bound to the old bytes.

parent_artifact_id.description: Optional parent artifact id when this run is nested under a larger research artifact.

activation_reference.description: Stable reference into an activation snapshot. Run State must not copy route/discipline/audit semantics.

pending_decision.description: Unconsumed user checkpoint. mid_review requires continue/narrow/pivot/stop-and-synthesize. delivered requires null. Resume must re-check this field.

last_transition_reason.description: Why the run entered its current (phase, status) pair.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 date (2026-08-25) or timezone-aware RFC 3339 timestamp. Naive datetimes and impossible calendar values fail validation.

enabled_reason.description: Why this Run State exists. parallel requires activation parallelization_decision=parallel when a snapshot is supplied. explicit_resume is the only lawful gate for single-track. Never enable because a Research Pack exists.

status_reason.description: Required for partial and blocked: the gap or block and its impact.

recovery_action.description: Required for blocked: what should be retried and how.

handoff_refs.description: Optional bindings to Track Handoff artifacts. Required when enabled_reason=parallel and phase is synthesizing, auditing, or delivered. Tampering a listed handoff file fails closed.
